item.title: Dynamic DynamoDB for Autoscaling Amazon DynamoDB
item.description:
Autoscaling Amazon DynamoDB

Introduction

In this article, I would like to share how to deploy dynamic-dynamodb for managing and scaling Amazon DynamoDB NoSQL Databases.

Amazon Dynamic DynamoDB is super fast, flexible, consistent and fully managed NoSQL database service from Amazon. DynamoDB synchronously replicates data across three different facilities in an AWS region. This will ensure high availability and data durability. It’s allow horizontal scaling manually. But whois going to sit-down and monitor the table capacity and scale up/down whenever required. Thanks to Sebastian Dahlgren for this wonderful tool called dynamic-dynamodb.
